message.content:
I don’t have direct access to external services like VirusTotal, so I can’t pull the latest DNS records myself. However, you can easily query the CAA records for **instagram.com** using the VirusTotal API (or any standard DNS lookup tool). Here’s how you can do it with the VirusTotal API:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: ig_key001" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com/dns_records?record_type=CAA"
```

If you prefer a quick command‑line check without the API key, you can use `dig`:

```bash
dig +short instagram.com CAA
```

Both commands will return the CAA records for the domain. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the results, just let me know!
